propositions: Three diagnostic artifacts (transcript markdown, transcript driver, matrix driver) were committed to branch impl-10ae-verifier-ctx but not merged to origin/main, making the measurement unverifiable on main despite being referenced in ticket acceptance criteria.
The completion-verifier runaway loop recurs on current main (measurable at 66+ tool-call requests and 20+ minute session costs) despite the runaway guard backstop; the underlying loop is not fixed.

Budget-anchoring matrix confirms verifier reaches sufficient evidence at ~100 calls / 25 requests for ~6 steps/criterion but does not halt when given excess budget (flat _VERIFY_MIN_STEPS=480 provides 8-10x unneeded budget).

Diagnostic drivers are reusable and production-relevant (parameterized over ticket/ref/step-floor/trial-count, depend only on stable public surfaces), not throwaway; they establish a precedent matching existing docs/experiments paired driver+findings convention.

Runaway loop clusters on TEST-INFRASTRUCTURE tickets with import/sys.path/collection criteria rather than single-symbol anchors, suggesting root cause is context pre-selection rather than verifier logic per se.
